karnak-temple-complex-begun.description: Workers in loincloths haul a large stone block on a wooden sledge with ropes while a figure in a blue crown and collar stands on a mound directing them. Behind them stand scribes with scrolls, a tall obelisk, a row of stone columns with wooden scaffolding, and palm trees along a Nile shore with sailing boats. The scene is warm, sandy and painted in oil style, with no visible text and no frame.

abu-simbel-temples-carved.description: Four colossal seated figures with striped headdresses are carved into a tan sandstone cliff beside a wide river with sailing boats and green banks. Small figures stand on wooden scaffolds and ladders and work around the statues' feet and laps. Hieroglyph-like carvings cover the cliff face, and a shadowed doorway opens between the statues' feet. The scene is a painting of stone carving, with no frame.

parthenon-dedicated-athena.description: A painted scene of a marble Doric temple with a row of columns and a sculpted pediment on a rocky hilltop, with scaffolding on its upper left. A crowd of robed people climbs stone steps, leading cattle and carrying offering baskets and a lit brazier, with smoke rising. The sky is golden and cloudy, and a smaller temple sits in the distance at left.

prophets-mosque-medina-built.description: Men in loose robes and head cloths build a mud-brick wall and lift a long palm trunk, while others work under a open palm-thatched roof held up by palm-trunk columns. Date palms tower over a dusty courtyard with low earthen walls, under a hazy sky.

great-mosque-cordoba-begun.description: An arcaded interior with red-and-white striped horseshoe arches on dark and pale columns. Workers on wooden scaffolding and pulley winches lift stone, and two men in robes and turbans consult a rolled plan in the foreground. Through the arches, a courtyard with orange trees and more scaffolding is visible under bright sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text.

westminster-abbey-consecrated.description: An oil-style painting of a dark, stormy evening. A stone church with a square tower and a steep roof stands on the right, its portal lit by torches. In the foreground, several men in dark tunics carry a large carved wooden chair on poles. Bishops in gold embroidered vestments and mitres walk toward the doorway, flanked by monks, torch-bearers and armoured men. A river with small boats lies to the left. There is no visible text, frame or border.

florence-cathedral-begun.description: Men in shirts and tunics dig deep trenches with shovels and carry baskets of earth. On the left, a stone church with a rose window and a crumbling wall stands beside them. In the centre, a hooded robed man at a trestle table unrolls a plan while stacks of green and pink marble blocks rest nearby. Torch-bearing onlookers in medieval dress stand at right. Oxen and carts fill the street, and a green-and-white striped marble cathedral facade rises in the background under a grey smoky sky.

st-basils-cathedral-completed.description: A painted view of a brick church with a cluster of colourful onion domes, one tall central tower wrapped in scaffolding with small figures on it. Dark stormy sky, a red brick Kremlin-style wall and a clock tower on the right, and figures in dark coats and some with pole weapons on a cobbled square in the foreground. Oil-painting style, filling the whole image edge to edge with no visible text.

st-pauls-cathedral-completed.description: A large stone cathedral with a silver-grey dome on a colonnaded drum, seen from a rooftop over a city of brick houses with chimneys smoking. In the foreground, a man in a grey periwig and dark coat looks up at the dome, beside a workman in an apron pointing upward with a plumb line. Stormy clouds with shafts of light fill the sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border or text visible.

sagrada-familia-begun.description: A dim, candlelit night scene of a crowd of men in 19th-century dark suits and top hats, plus clergy in white and gold vestments, gathered at the edge of a pit. A large rough stone block hangs from ropes over the pit. On the right, workers lean over a wooden trestle table holding a model of a spired, tall-towered church. Torches and lanterns light the scene, with a city skyline under a cloudy dusk sky in the background. I see no legible text, no frame or border, and no gore.
